subject: math
source: Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics 0580 (Extended) syllabus 2025–2027, Cambridge International

weeks.topic: Types of number: primes, factors, multiples, HCF and LCM
objectives: Identify natural numbers, integers, primes, rational and irrational numbers
Find HCF and LCM using prime factorisation

weeks.topic: Fractions, decimals and percentages: equivalence and ordering
objectives: Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages
Order quantities and use the four operations with fractions

weeks.topic: Standard form and efficient calculator use
objectives: Write and calculate with numbers in standard form
Use a calculator efficiently and check answers

weeks.topic: Estimation, rounding and limits of accuracy (upper and lower bounds)
objectives: Round to decimal places and significant figures
Find upper and lower bounds of calculations

weeks.topic: Ratio, proportion and rates
objectives: Divide a quantity in a given ratio
Solve problems involving rates and best buys

weeks.topic: Percentages: increase, decrease, reverse percentages and interest
objectives: Calculate percentage change and reverse percentages
Use simple and compound interest formulae

weeks.topic: Algebraic manipulation: expanding brackets and factorising
objectives: Expand products of brackets
Factorise by common factor, grouping and difference of two squares

weeks.topic: Linear equations and changing the subject of a formula
objectives: Solve linear equations including fractions
Rearrange formulae where the subject appears twice

weeks.topic: Indices: laws of indices, zero, negative and fractional powers
objectives: Apply the laws of indices to numbers and algebra
Evaluate negative and fractional indices

weeks.topic: Sequences: nth term of linear, quadratic, cubic and geometric sequences
objectives: Continue sequences and find the nth term
Recognise linear, quadratic, cubic and geometric patterns

weeks.topic: Coordinate geometry: gradient, length and midpoint of a line segment
objectives: Calculate gradient, length and midpoint from coordinates
Interpret gradient as rate of change

weeks.topic: Straight-line graphs and the equation y = mx + c
objectives: Draw and interpret graphs of linear functions
Find the equation of a line from its graph or two points

weeks.topic: Simultaneous linear equations
objectives: Solve simultaneous equations by elimination and substitution
Solve them graphically and form them from contexts

weeks.topic: Angle properties: parallel lines, triangles and polygons
objectives: Use angle facts on parallel lines and in polygons
Calculate interior and exterior angles of polygons

weeks.topic: Term 1 review: number, algebra basics, coordinate geometry and angles
objectives: Consolidate number and algebra skills from Term 1
Practise mixed exam-style questions

weeks.topic: Linear inequalities and regions on graphs
objectives: Solve linear inequalities and show them on a number line
Represent and interpret regions defined by inequalities

weeks.topic: Quadratic expressions: factorising and solving by factorisation
objectives: Factorise quadratics including ax² + bx + c
Solve quadratic equations by factorising

weeks.topic: Completing the square and the quadratic formula
objectives: Solve quadratics by completing the square
Use the quadratic formula and give answers to a required accuracy

weeks.topic: Pythagoras' theorem and right-angled trigonometry
objectives: Apply Pythagoras' theorem in 2D problems
Use sine, cosine and tangent to find sides and angles

weeks.topic: Mensuration: perimeter and area including arcs and sectors
objectives: Find areas of triangles, parallelograms, trapezia and circles
Calculate arc length and sector area

weeks.topic: Mensuration: surface area and volume of prisms, cylinders, cones and spheres
objectives: Calculate volumes and surface areas of 3D solids
Solve problems with compound shapes

weeks.topic: Similarity and congruence; areas and volumes of similar shapes
objectives: Use scale factors for lengths, areas and volumes
Apply congruence conditions for triangles

weeks.topic: Geometrical constructions, scale drawings and bearings
objectives: Construct triangles and bisectors with ruler and compasses
Interpret scale drawings and three-figure bearings

weeks.topic: Probability: single events, relative and expected frequency
objectives: Calculate probabilities of single events
Use relative frequency to estimate probability and expected frequency

weeks.topic: Probability of combined events: tree diagrams and sample spaces
objectives: Use sample space and tree diagrams
Calculate probabilities with and without replacement

weeks.topic: Statistics: classifying data and averages (mean, median, mode, range)
objectives: Classify discrete and continuous data
Calculate and compare averages and range

weeks.topic: Mid-year exams: Term 1 and Term 2 content
objectives: Sit timed papers covering number, algebra, geometry and probability
Identify topics for follow-up

weeks.topic: Statistics: charts, scatter diagrams and correlation
objectives: Draw and interpret bar charts, pie charts and stem-and-leaf diagrams
Describe correlation and draw a line of best fit

weeks.topic: Sets: notation and Venn diagrams
objectives: Use set notation including ∪, ∩, complement and subsets
Solve problems with Venn diagrams of two or three sets

weeks.topic: Graphs of functions: quadratic, cubic, reciprocal and exponential
objectives: Plot and recognise the shapes of non-linear graphs
Solve equations approximately from graphs

weeks.topic: Real-life graphs: distance–time and speed–time
objectives: Interpret gradients and areas in kinematic graphs
Calculate acceleration and distance travelled

weeks.topic: Transformations: reflection, rotation, translation and enlargement
objectives: Perform and describe single transformations fully
Use column vectors for translations and negative scale factors

weeks.topic: Symmetry of 2D shapes and 3D solids
objectives: Identify line and rotational symmetry
Recognise planes and axes of symmetry in solids

weeks.topic: Money, exchange rates and time calculations
objectives: Convert currencies using exchange rates
Solve problems with timetables, 12- and 24-hour clocks

weeks.topic: Direct and inverse proportion (variation)
objectives: Form equations for direct and inverse variation
Solve problems involving y ∝ xⁿ and y ∝ 1/xⁿ

weeks.topic: End-of-year exams: Year 10 content
objectives: Sit Paper 2 and Paper 4 style exams on Year 10 topics
Practise showing full working

weeks.topic: Year 10 review and preview of Year 11 algebra and functions
objectives: Correct exam errors and target weak topics
Preview functions and algebraic fractions
